No obfuscated code, unauthorized network requests, or dangerous operations (e.g., `eval`, `base64` decoding, or remote code execution) are present. The package installs into standard system paths (`/usr/share/webapps`, `/etc/webapps`) with appropriate permissions and includes a configuration file managed via pacman's backup mechanism. All operations align with standard AUR packaging practices for a web application.
</details>
